dsp_configuration.partial_windows: discarded; no padding or tail flush
dsp_configuration.power: one-sided integrated mean-square, fractional bin-cell overlaps
dsp_configuration.reported_time: audio-relative end of capture read containing the completed FFT window
dsp_configuration.resampling: causal polyphase FIR; Hamming window; 20*max(up,down)+1 taps; no delay compensation
dsp_configuration.timing_excludes: OS/backend scheduling, DSP execution time, presentation and hardware output
